result.title: SpatialScout-V2: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore Real-World 3D Scenes and Localize Objects?
result.summary: Spatial intelligence requires agents to acquire visual evidence and integrate partial observations into coherent three-dimensional representations. We introduce SpatialScout-V2, which extends SpatialScout's active mapping task from simulation to real residential scenes through three advances: real visual observations, preservation of original scene content, and interactive exploration of recorded views. Built from 100 homes in Realsee3D, the benchmark covers 3,171 target objects across 29 categories. Given a fixed target inventory, agents autonomously select recorded viewpoints and viewing directions, integrate calibrated RGB observations, and iteratively estimate and revise object centers within a fixed interaction budget. We evaluate the localization accuracy and completeness of object-center maps using mean IoU, IoU-threshold hit rates, and target coverage. Evaluating seven frontier vision-language models (VLMs), we find that six achieve an all-target mean IoU below 20\%. Even the best-performing model, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches only 22.52\%, with just 18.36\% of targets exceeding an IoU of 0.5. Further analysis shows that broad submission coverage can coexist with limited localization accuracy, while target omissions further reduce overall scores. These results highlight substantial challenges in constructing accurate and complete object-center maps through active exploration of real scenes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SpatialScout-V2 真实住宅 3D 场景主动探索基准，要求 VLM 代理在固定交互预算内选择记录视角、整合标定 RGB 观测并迭代估计物体中心；覆盖 100 个家庭、3171 个目标、29 个类别，并用平均 IoU、命中率和目标覆盖率评测七个前沿 VLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 中 LOOK 和证据获取直接相关：该基准将视觉证据筛选、部分观测整合及预算约束下的探索决策放到真实场景中检验，可供核查精度—覆盖率权衡与失败模式，但不涉及 latent 推理状态的生成机制。
